scope: Every external boundary of the noble-wasm extraction (translation.json functions that are not local, globals and types in the External templates, and local opaque functions), each with the Lean module that must define its model and the review class of that model. verification/m3-wasm/implementation.mjs refuses a translation whose boundary set differs; proofs/m3-wasm/ExtractionGate.lean refuses a model defined outside its recorded module, an axiom, or an unsafe definition.

review_classes.kernel-delegation: Calls the inherited kernel extraction (proofs/m3/NobleKernel) through the total, lossless KernelBridge conversions; failures and divergence propagate.
review_classes.kernel-constant: The inherited kernel extraction value of the same Rust constant.
review_classes.kernel-type: Alias of the inherited kernel type or of its reviewed external type model.
review_classes.frontend-delegation: Calls the actual extracted frontend function (proofs/mc1/NobleContractImpl) through the total, lossless ContractsBridge and KernelBridge conversions; failures and divergence propagate.
review_classes.frontend-constant: The actual extracted frontend value of the same Rust constant.
review_classes.frontend-type: Alias of the actual extracted frontend type or of its reviewed external type model.
review_classes.inherited-model: Calls the inherited kernel or frontend model of the same Rust item, already reviewed in that lane.
review_classes.std-value-model: Value model of the Rust standard-library item following the pinned std source: supplied trait implementations run in Rust order with their failures; allocation, capacity and layout are not represented (see the StdModels.lean header).
review_classes.std-value-type: Value-only representation of the standard-library type (see TypesExternal.lean).
review_classes.undefined-outside-value-model: Returns fail .undef, directly or through the inherited kernel model: the Rust value depends on allocation identity, type layout, raw-pointer provenance or hasher write splitting, which the value model cannot represent, so no ok result is claimed (see the StdModels.lean header).
review_classes.opaque-rendering: The crate's reviewed #[charon::opaque] Debug rendering, modelled as the abstract-formatter pass-through it computes (see FunsExternal.lean).
